pl-l4d27c2-d1e115.summary: Defines nuptials or marriage as the marital union of man and woman between lawful persons, maintaining an undivided way of life.
claims: Marriage is the marital union of lawful persons in undivided life.

pl-l4d27c2-d1e121.summary: Explains that undivided life means neither can profess continence or devote time to prayer without the other's consent; the marriage bond remains between them while they live, so neither may join another; and each owes the other what each owes himself. This definition includes only the marriage of lawful and faithful persons.
claims: Neither spouse may profess continence alone.
The definition covers lawful and faithful marriage.

pl-l4d27c2.summary: Defines marriage as the marital union of man and woman between lawful persons, maintaining an undivided way of life. Undivided life means neither may profess continence or devote themselves to prayer without the other's consent, the bond lasts while they live so neither may join another, and each owes the other what each owes himself. This definition includes only the marriage of lawful and faithful persons.
claims: Marriage is the marital union of lawful persons in an undivided way of life.
Neither spouse may profess continence without the other's consent.
The marriage bond lasts for life.
